Private 10-day outpatient addiction program in NW Calgary with counsellor Bobby Bains, at home or at the Crowfoot office. $190 sessions. Call for intake.

centre.name: Gobind Wellness
centre.address: 600 Crowfoot Crescent NW #340, Calgary, AB T3G 0B4, Canada

about_blocks.text: Gobind Wellness runs its Calgary work from Suite 340 at 600 Crowfoot Crescent NW, in the Crowfoot area of the city's northwest. It is a private addiction counselling and recovery coaching practice, not a treatment centre with beds. Founder Bobby Bains, an addictions counsellor and recovery coach, delivers the program in person, and the same practice also has an office in South Surrey, BC.

about_blocks.text: The service most Calgary clients book is a 10-day outpatient program. For 10 days in a row you have a two-hour one-to-one session, either at home or at the Crowfoot office, and then go to a one-hour community support meeting in the evening. You sleep in your own bed throughout. The Calgary program page frames it for people who cannot step away from a job, a business or young kids for a month or more of residential rehab.

about_blocks.text: Each day has a theme. The first few look at how the addiction took hold, your own patterns and the ways denial kept it going. The middle days deal with emotions, daily habits and who you are without drinking or using. Day 7 is about relationships and boundaries, day 8 about purpose, and day 9 is spent writing a relapse prevention plan. Day 10 pulls it all into a longer term plan, and phone support for you and your family carries on after that.

about_blocks.text: There is also a 30-day live-in option, which the practice offers in Calgary as well as Surrey. A recovery specialist stays with you day and night, in your home or in Gobind Wellness accommodation, and the month includes random testing, exercise, meal prep and daily meetings. It is supervision rather than a licensed residential program, and there are no doctors or nurses on staff, so medical detox has to happen elsewhere.

about_blocks.text: Gobind Wellness is private pay. One-to-one counselling or coaching costs $190 an hour, in person or by Zoom or phone, and the 10-hour online program is listed at $1,800. The 10-day and 30-day programs are quoted on request. It is not part of Recovery Alberta's publicly funded services and does not bill insurers, but you can claim the receipts through an extended health plan if yours covers it.

centre.faq_heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Gobind Wellness

faqs.question: Is Gobind Wellness in Calgary an inpatient rehab?

answer_blocks.text: No. It is a private outpatient counselling and recovery coaching practice in NW Calgary, and you live at home during the 10-day program. Sessions take place at your home or at the office on Crowfoot Crescent. A separate 30-day live-in option puts a recovery specialist with you around the clock, but that is supervised support and not a licensed residential treatment facility.

faqs.question: How does the 10-day program work in Calgary?

answer_blocks.text: You meet Bobby Bains for two hours a day, one to one, on 10 consecutive days, then attend a one-hour community support meeting each evening. That adds up to 30 hours. Each day has its own focus, from triggers and denial early on to relationships, purpose and a written relapse prevention plan near the end. The practice says it limits how many people start in each intake.

faqs.question: Is it covered by Alberta Health Care or Recovery Alberta?

answer_blocks.text: No. Gobind Wellness is a private-pay service, so Alberta Health Care (AHCIP) and Recovery Alberta do not fund it. The practice does not bill insurers directly either. You can send your receipts to your extended health or workplace benefits plan, but check first whether it covers an addictions counsellor or recovery coach.

faqs.question: Can I detox at Gobind Wellness?

answer_blocks.text: No. The practice does not provide medical detox, and its website says its staff are not doctors. It asks new clients to see their family physician about withdrawal before they start. If you drink heavily every day or use opioids or benzodiazepines, arrange medically supervised withdrawal first, through your doctor or Recovery Alberta's detox services.

faqs.question: Where is the Calgary office and how do I get there?

answer_blocks.text: The office is in Suite 340 at 600 Crowfoot Crescent NW, Calgary, AB T3G 0B4, in the Crowfoot shopping and office area. It is about 20 to 25 minutes by car from downtown Calgary via Crowchild Trail and close to Crowfoot CTrain station on the Red Line. Many clients never come to the office, because sessions can happen at home anywhere in Calgary and nearby communities.

Bobby Bains will also travel to clients elsewhere in the country, with extra charges for bookings outside Calgary and the Lower Mainland of BC.
